title: TEC WGs Bi-Weekly Update: July 18 - Aug 01

posts.cooked:
Monday, August 1st, 2022

Good Monday everyone! Community calls are now biweekly. So, here is a summary of what has been going on in the TEC for the past 2 weeks.

Remember that you can always check our calendar to see what’s going on. You may also join us in real time during any of the syncs, or go to our YouTube channel archive for hundreds of recorded calls.

Stewards

Stewards: Tamara, Nate
Weekly Sync: Tuesday, 1PM EST/7PM CET

  • We are on sprint #39. Here is the sprint board where you can see what issues we are working on.
  • On the Stewards Council we talked about Burnout and what we can do about it.
  • We are developing a TEC Roadmap.
  • Edu is going to be training new leadership for communitas as we transform into new a steward organization.
  • Remember that you can easily help the TEC by retweeting

Gravity

Steward: Juan
Weekly Sync: Wednesday, 11AM EST/5PM CET

  • The Third Graviton Training has finished!. By now, we have trained over 80 gravitons
  • Join us on Mondays for observational research on psychology and wellbeing. We are currently working on a survey to measure wellbeing and mental health.
  • On Tuesday we are going to have a graviton get together.
  • On Thursday we’ll talk about Burnout in Aragon.
  • Last Friday we had Campfire in Aragon where we talked about conflict management skills and tools.
  • We are currently drafting the 2nd proposal that we will submit to TEC.
  • We also have a project on Giveth, and that means we can recieve donations from Giveth!
  • If you’re in need of help managing a conflict, you can make a request through our typeform

  • Check our SWOT Analysis of the TEC. If you have any input, you’re welcome to add it to the file It will help us do a better analysis.

Thank you for reading the WG Bi-Weekly Update from July 18 - Aug 01. Check our calendar and join us on a call soon!
